scope: Spirit Island original 2017 standard base/core, balanced maps, standard Blight Cards and one-Spirit solo; applicable official original-core corrections/clarifications including initial +1 Blight and action-tree outcomes. Excludes adversaries, scenarios, thematic maps, optional difficulty/performance scoring, expansions, promos and later-product examples.
conclusion: No material false rule, important procedural omission, cost/destination error, timing error, or excluded-product rule/card was found in the final candidate against the assigned source corpus. Individual Spirit panels and component instructions are explicitly delegated and were respected as such.

independence.notes: Only assigned candidate and source content were read. Directory metadata discovery exposed helper filenames/hashes but no helper/report contents were opened. Catalog labels and manifest locator_set_only fields were not used as membership authority. No repairs were authored.

checked_claims.claim: Overview, cooperative shared outcomes, 1–4 Spirits, 90–120 minutes, designer, original-core scope and component inventory
checked_claims.detail: Counts checked including 13 Presence/color, four Unique cards/Spirit, 36 Minor/22 Major, 15 Invader/15 Fear, 2 Blight cards, reminder/Energy/player-aid/progression components; excluded panels accurately identified as box contents.

checked_claims.claim: Standard balanced-board setup, map layouts, board icons, separate supply, randomization and initial Explore
checked_claims.detail: One board/Spirit, independent stage shuffles/removal unseen, 3/4/5 Invader stack, random nine Fear cards with 3/3/3 dividers, initial Explore to Build and empty Ravage verified.

checked_claims.claim: Initial Blight correction, flip refills, no-card teaching alternative and teaching progression
checked_claims.detail: 2/Spirit+1 total or 5/Spirit+1 total only initially; no repeated +1 on flip; setup Blight from box/no destruction or cascade; progressive cards still require Major Forget.

checked_claims.claim: Spirit setup choices, tracks, own starting board, Presence limits and destroyed Presence
checked_claims.detail: Separate setup placements may share a land; starting board does not constrain later actions; unused track disks and destroyed disks remain distinct.

checked_claims.claim: Spirit-phase order, simultaneous coordination and phase barrier
checked_claims.detail: Each Spirit Growth→Energy→play/pay, all complete before Fast; later Fast income cannot pay earlier plays.

checked_claims.claim: Growth mandatory instructions, skipping impossible parts, option costs, chaining Add Presence, repositioning and Move distinction
checked_claims.detail: Range selected before picking a repositioned disk; any current disk can supply repositioning; newly added disk can originate next placement; destroyed Presence only by explicit permission; normal Reclaim excludes in-play/forgotten cards.

checked_claims.claim: Energy/Card Plays/Elements/Reclaim One and flexible Element timing
checked_claims.detail: Highest numeric track benefit, no summation/carrying card plays, unspent Energy retained, card Elements immediate/unspent while in play, passive track Elements additional, flexible action-granted Elements chosen immediately.

checked_claims.claim: Fast and Slow Power phases, one Power at a time, foregoing effects and no implicit extra activation
checked_claims.detail: Targets selected on use; Fast cannot be delayed to Slow; played Elements retained if foregoing effects; target/use requires attempting text, self-Speed/Range modification alone insufficient.

checked_claims.claim: Invader phase/Fear order, Stage II Coastal/ignored flags, Stage III terrains and qualifying-land list timing
checked_claims.detail: Lands fixed per card before resolving; matching already-queued Ravage receives later-arriving Invaders; land order freely chosen/interleaved; new eligible lands not added mid-card.

checked_claims.claim: Ravage damage/Defend, Blight, Dahan efficient allocation and counterattack
checked_claims.detail: 1/2/3 Invader damage applied separately/equally/simultaneously to land and Dahan; 2+ land damage one Blight; survivors 2 damage each even when defended to zero; no fight if action skipped; early Dahan damage replaces regular timing; Earth's destroyed defending site not retroactive.

checked_claims.claim: Build and Explore eligibility, piece destinations, advancement and deck exhaustion
checked_claims.detail: Build one City only if Town count greater than City count, otherwise Town, from supply without upgrading; Explore one from supply despite multiple sources; Explorers not sources; skip elsewhere does not erase sources; lose on required absent draw, not last existing reveal.

checked_claims.claim: Power targeting, one land/turn/use, mandatory text/choices/threshold consistency and changing Elements
checked_claims.detail: Source and target boxes constrain use; slash is union; explicit Instead replaces earlier levels; consistently pretending fewer Elements for entire Power is permitted; resolve all qualifying instructions in order; Speed/Range/target modifiers checked before targeting.

checked_claims.claim: Gain/Forget/transfer/extra-play procedures, card costs and card destinations
checked_claims.detail: Choose deck/draw4/keep1/discard3, reshuffle when necessary; any owned card may be Forgotten including new Major or card in play; correct shared discard or under-panel destinations; immediate Element loss but resolved effects persist; distinct Forget per Major; gifts/takes treated by wording; extra play beyond track does not immediately resolve.

checked_claims.claim: Damage/Destroy/Remove/Replace/Health and Defend distinctions
checked_claims.detail: Damage defaults Invaders, freely allocated and accumulates in turn; damage is distinct from Health; replacement retains damage and can cause destruction; destruction Fear separate from explicit Fear, no automatic Remove/Replace Fear; Concealing Shadows only Ravaging Invader damage to Dahan, land unchanged and protected survivors counterattack.

checked_claims.claim: Gather/Push/Move and Repeat procedures
checked_claims.detail: Adjacency movement distinct from numeric Range; mandatory numeric count as possible and up-to zero; no self-Gather/Push, generic Move can stay; Repeat another use not play/extra printed Elements; current Elements/most recently assigned speed, explicit repeat destination override and no repeat chains; Range/Speed modification persists without repeated stacking.

checked_claims.claim: General Range boosts, ownership, internal arrow origins and restriction limits
sources: Core .3y28aqg, .7w4g8nq, special-rule-range-bonuses-to-targeting; complete what-do-range-boosts-affect.html/.txt and range-in-text-of-powers-that-target-spirits.html/.txt; reaching_grasp.jpg; blazing_renewal.jpg
checked_claims.detail: Printed numeric Range arrows of user's actions/Powers affected subject to bonus limits; no increasing another Range bonus or another Spirit's Powers merely because targeted; Reaching Grasp +2 remains +2; Power-only boosts do not extend Growth; Shadows special boost affects target box only; Spirit-targeting effects measure instructed Spirit's Presence but use Power user's bonus; Blazing Renewal expressly originates from user; land-targeting text originates target land.

checked_claims.claim: Time Passes and permanent versus temporary effects
checked_claims.detail: Played cards personal discard, surviving damage cleared, card Elements/single-turn effects clear, track Elements and retained Energy persist, physical board/Fear changes remain.

checked_claims.claim: Victory/Terror conditions, all three loss routes and action-tree sacrifice outcomes
checked_claims.detail: No Invaders / no buildings / no Cities / earn last Fear card; finish originating action and all triggered descendants, cleanup then check; check before next independent Power/land action, victory plus defeat sacrifice; current Terror dividers immediate, last Fear text unnecessary.

checked_claims.detail: After entire originating action, not individual instructions; no self-trigger even indirectly; separately repeated instances can trigger one another without looping own branch.
